canh.prompt: A slow push-in camera captures the classroom. Hân Hân holds the wooden caravel ship model, gently turning it in her hands while her mouth moves in natural speech. In the background, sunlight shifts softly across the classroom walls, and dust motes drift lazily in the air.

Hân Hân stands on the left, gently gesturing toward a large map on the wall with a serious expression and natural lip movement as she speaks. Nhật Minh stands beside her, crossing his arms and slightly turning his head to inspect the room. In the background, dust motes drift softly through a beam of warm light illuminating the detailed map.

A slow push-in camera captures the deck of the ancient ship. In the background at the bow, Columbus raises an antique brass spyglass to his eye. Gentle ocean waves ripple against the hull, and a soft sea breeze flutters their hair and clothing.

In the quiet corner of the dock, poor peasants in ragged clothes walk slowly past with weary postures. In the distant calm water, a solemn trading ship drifts steadily forward with its sails fluttering gently in the sea breeze.
